technical.summary: GPC shows solid structural bullish alignment (price above all MAs, supertrend, Ichimoku) but momentum is deteriorating (stoch bearish cross, MACD crossover down, RSI not rising), creating a conflicted setup with moderate entry quality.

fundamental.summary: GPC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 87 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with only small sales from junior members 189+ days ago; market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data and conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (251.5) indicates extreme market stress, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction in risk-off environment; 87-day earnings window adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price structure remains above all major moving averages with supertrend and Ichimoku bullish, and market fear (VIX crisis) creates contrarian opportunity for mean reversion if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum is actively deteriorating (stoch bearish cross, MACD crossover down, RSI stalling) into a macro crisis environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 251.5, recession signals), with zero fundamental catalysts and no strategy triggered—risk/reward heavily skewed to downside.

decision.entry_rationale: GPC retains structural bullish alignment (price above MAs, supertrend, Ichimoku) and market fear presents contrarian opportunity; however, deteriorating momentum (stoch bearish cross, MACD crossover down) into macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 251.5) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry merit.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis-level stress signal recession environment where Consumer Discretionary demand destruction accelerates, while momentum deterioration suggests structural support may fail on macro shock.
